clue.text: I am leading fashion styles — not half boasting

indicators.note: leading puts the first piece ahead of what follows

parts.note: I am contracts to I'm
a fashion is a mode

indicators.note: not half keeps only the first three of the six letters of styles

explanation.surface: Someone grandly showing off the latest fashion styles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not half' trims styles to its first half, STY.
explanation.definitionFit: Boasting is a lack of modesty about oneself, a noun synonym for vain self-display.

clue.text: Substantial beer cut by chancellor, perhaps

indicators.note: cut by means the beer word is split open with the other piece set inside

parts.note: ale is a beer
the Chancellor of the Exchequer is an example of an MP, a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A hefty beer price rise imposed by the Chancellor in the budget.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the Chancellor sets beer duty; here he is just an example of an MP.
explanation.definitionFit: Substantial and ample both describe a generous or plentiful quantity, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: A week in spring with strikes leads to urgent negotiations

parts.note: strikes means hits

indicators.note: the leads of the two words are their first letters

explanation.surface: Industrial action in springtime forces urgent talks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A week' looks like W, but it belongs to the definition; W comes from 'with'.
explanation.definitionFit: Whit week is the Christian festival week around Pentecost, falling in spring.

clue.text: Get excited about radius bone

indicators.note: about means the phrase goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: to get excited is to be stirred up, here to stir up
R is the standard abbreviation for radius in geometry

explanation.surface: Getting worked up about a bone in the forearm.
explanation.walkthrough: The radius is a forearm bone, a false trail; it only gives R.
explanation.definitionFit: The stapes, a tiny bone of the middle ear, is commonly called by this name for its shape.

clue.text: What I can make with hooter around?

definitions.text: What I can make with hooter around?

indicators.note: around means the nose word encloses the letter I

parts.note: hooter is slang for nose

explanation.surface: Someone wondering how loud they could be with a car horn.
explanation.walkthrough: Hooter is both a horn and slang for a nose; put the nose around I.
explanation.definitionFit: Sounding a hooter makes a din, so the whole clue describes loud sound.

clue.text: Watching musical about not including tax returns

indicators.note: returns means the whole assembly is read backwards
about means the musical goes around the other piece

parts.note: Evita is the Lloyd Webber musical
nett (net) means after deductions such as tax

explanation.surface: An accountant at a musical, thinking about tax returns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tax returns' looks like one phrase, but 'returns' reverses the whole build, EVITNETTA, after 'about' places the net figure inside the musical.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone watching closely is paying attention, so the adjective is a synonym.

clue.text: Name of children's game

definitions.meaning: a ... is a label or name, as in a name ...
a chasing game where the one who is it touches others

explanation.definitionFit: A tag is a label naming something, and also the playground chasing game.

clue.text: Rashly put on season that's not pre-planned

indicators.note: doing something rashly means doing it wildly, so the letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: A show rushed into production for the new season.
explanation.definitionFit: Spontaneous actions happen on impulse, without any planning beforehand.

clue.text: An American jewel discovered in chair stuffing

indicators.note: discovered in means the pieces are found inside the chair word

parts.note: a chair is a seat
an gives the letter A
USA, the United States, stands in for American
a jewel is a gem

explanation.surface: Someone finds an American's jewel in the upholstery of a chair.
explanation.walkthrough: Chair stuffing reads as upholstery, but the definition is just 'stuffing', as for a turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: Minced seasoned pork is used as stuffing for poultry, so the meat is a kind of stuffing.

clue.text: Cunning what killer does concealing blood group

indicators.note: concealing means the blood group is put out of sight, so it is removed

parts.note: a killer slays
A is one of the blood groups

explanation.surface: A murderer cleverly hiding blood evidence.
explanation.definitionFit: Cunning and sly both describe someone crafty and deceitful.

clue.text: Saracens running rings round United with confidence

indicators.note: rings round means the shuffled letters encircle the other piece
running means the letters are on the move, rearranged

parts.note: U is the abbreviation for United in team names

explanation.surface: The Saracens rugby team outclassing a United side.
explanation.walkthrough: Saracens is a London rugby club. 'running' turns SARACENS into ASSRANCE, around U.
explanation.definitionFit: Assurance means self-confidence, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Source of vocal sounds using very unusual letters, awkward for beginners

indicators.note: for beginners means only the beginning letters of these words are used

explanation.surface: Unusual letters are hard for learners to pronounce.
explanation.definitionFit: The fleshy flap at the back of the throat helps shape sounds in speech.

clue.text: Key question about queen's personal attendant

parts.note: E is a musical key

indicators.note: about means the question word goes around the queen

parts.note: a question is a query
R, for Regina, is the abbreviation for queen

explanation.surface: Questioning the Queen's personal aide.
explanation.definitionFit: An equerry is an officer in personal attendance on a member of the royal family.

clue.text: Agrees everything must be within limits

indicators.note: within means everything sits inside the limits word

parts.note: ties are restrictions or limits
everything means all

explanation.surface: Someone agreeing that everything must stay within bounds.
explanation.definitionFit: When two figures tally they agree or match, so the verb is a synonym.

clue.text: Like a bore I had encountered during short lecture

indicators.note: during means the contraction comes in the middle of the other piece
short means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a lecture is a talk
I had contracts to I'd

explanation.surface: Someone stuck with a tedious speaker during a brief lecture.
explanation.walkthrough: A bore is a dull person, but here it is a tidal bore, a wave surging up a river. 'short' turns TALK into TAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A bore is a surge wave caused by the tide in an estuary, so it is tide-driven.

clue.text: Market your social event, getting married — and suffering

parts.note: a mart is a market
yr is a written abbreviation for your
a do is a party or social event

explanation.surface: Promoting a wedding party ends in misery.
explanation.definitionFit: Martyrdom is the condition of great suffering, especially for a cause.

clue.text: One round and pale American

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
a round shape is the letter O
wan means pale

explanation.surface: A pale American looking unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from Iowa, a Midwestern state, is an American.

clue.text: Sending away male in ill health

parts.note: being in ill health is ailing

explanation.surface: A man in poor health being sent off.
explanation.definitionFit: Mailing something means posting it, sending it off.

clue.text: Indigestion from fluid sipped, say

indicators.note: fluid means not fixed in form, so these letters flow into a new order

explanation.surface: Indigestion from a drink one sipped.
explanation.definitionFit: Dyspepsia is the medical term for indigestion.

clue.text: Person again travelling from an eastern country

indicators.note: travelling means the letters move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A person travelling again from the Far East.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from Singapore, a Southeast Asian nation, is described by this adjective.

clue.text: Certainly looks at dropping Ecstasy

indicators.note: dropping means the drug's letter is left out

parts.note: to look at something is to eye it
E is slang for the drug Ecstasy

explanation.surface: Someone eyeing a drug, sure to drop it.
explanation.definitionFit: Certainly is an emphatic way of saying yes as an affirmation.

clue.text: A pork pie, new, from abroad

parts.note: pork pie is rhyming slang for lie (a porky)

explanation.surface: A freshly made pork pie imported from overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: Pork pie, or porky, is British rhyming slang for a lie.
explanation.definitionFit: Alien as an adjective means foreign, coming from another country.

clue.text: Left in charge of Othello's first entrance

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

indicators.note: first means only the initial letter is taken

explanation.surface: A stage direction leaving Othello in charge of the entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: A portico is a columned porch at the entrance of a building.

clue.text: Particularly fast train left capital for York

parts.note: an express is a fast train

indicators.note: capital means the initial capital letter of the word

explanation.surface: A fast train leaves the capital for York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like London, but it is the first letter of York.
explanation.definitionFit: Expressly means specifically, for a particular purpose.

clue.text: Exactly where the rent goes

definitions.meaning: precisely, following instructions in every detail
rent is paid to the landlord, the one who lets the property

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means precisely; jokingly, rent goes to whoever lets the flat.

clue.text: Will volunteers join fellows in experiment?

indicators.note: in means the volunteers and fellows go inside the experiment word

parts.note: an experiment is a test
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
fellows are men

explanation.surface: Asking whether volunteers will join colleagues in a trial.
explanation.walkthrough: The Territorial Army (TA) is Britain's part-time volunteer force.
explanation.definitionFit: A will is a last testament, the legal document disposing of property.

clue.text: Gluttony I found out of order — that sin I did not commit

definitions.text: that sin I did not commit

indicators.note: out of order means the letters are not in their proper sequence

explanation.surface: Someone accused of gluttony denies the sin.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleading this verdict declares one did not commit the offence charged.

clue.text: Suspect runs round, offering no resistance

indicators.note: R stands for resistance in physics, so every R is removed

explanation.surface: A suspect gives himself up without a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: Both Rs leave 'runs round'; what remains spells the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsound as an adjective means unreliable or doubtful, so suspect.

clue.text: Deliberately contrived to stop working when boss is about

indicators.note: is about means the boss word surrounds the other piece

parts.note: a boss is a stud, a raised ornament
a machine that stops working dies

explanation.surface: Downing tools whenever the boss is around.
explanation.walkthrough: Boss means a knob or stud, not the manager the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: A studied manner is carefully calculated rather than natural.

clue.text: As a green belt, sport really must be taken at regular intervals

parts.note: RU is Rugby Union

indicators.note: regular intervals means every other letter is taken

explanation.surface: Green-belt land where sport must be played regularly.
explanation.walkthrough: A green belt is protected countryside around a British city.
explanation.definitionFit: Green-belt land is countryside, so it is rural in character.

clue.text: A ritual springing up in place providing tea

indicators.note: in a down clue, springing up means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: Mass is a religious ritual

explanation.surface: A ceremony at a tea plantation.
explanation.definitionFit: Assam, a state in northeast India, is famous for growing tea.

clue.text: Vegetable — lots pulled up with nitrogen deficiency

indicators.note: in a down clue, pulled up means the word reads upward
a deficiency means something is lacking, so the element is taken out

parts.note: lots means many
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A gardener pulling up vegetables that lack nitrogen.
explanation.walkthrough: Without N, MANY becomes MAY, which 'pulled up' turns around.
explanation.definitionFit: A yam is a starchy tuber eaten as a vegetable.
